post.summary: Execute an entity action using the integration engine.
post.description: Execute an entity action. Quota: a `switchable.open` (door open) consumes 1 from `door_opens` (unit: count, per day and per month); when invoked via an API key it additionally consumes 1 from `voice_invocations` (unit: count, per day). When the org is over capacity, a degraded open may be delayed (the response carries a `degradation` warning) but is never blocked. An applicable `require_step_up` policy requires a prior authenticated preview or confirmation response; retry the same org, principal, entity, action, and JSON payload with its short-lived, single-use value in `X-OpenApp-Confirm`. The proof expires after 10 minutes and is not a separate second factor. Agents should also send `Idempotency-Key`. Success JSON includes `correlation_id`.

post.summary: Create an access invite granting portal_open on one or more portals.
post.description:
Safe for at-least-once delivery from an external system of record:

* `Idempotency-Key` makes a retried create replay the original result instead of creating a
  second invitation. The replayed body omits the one-time `invite_token` / `invite_url` and sets
  `idempotent_replay`.
* `external_ref` binds the invitation to a record in the calling system. A second create for the
  same record is rejected with `external_reference_conflict`; use the reconcile route to make an
  existing invitation match a desired state.
* `X-Correlation-Id` (or `X-Request-Id`) is stored with the invitation and on every audit event
  for the write, and echoed back on the response.

parameters.description: Replay key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original result without creating a second invitation.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Caller request id recorded with the invitation and its audit events.

200.description: Created invite (or replay of an earlier create with the same Idempotency-Key)

post.summary: Make the invitation state for an external record equal a desired state.
post.description:
This is the operation a system of record needs: it addresses the invitation by
`external_ref`, so the caller never has to discover or store OpenApp invitation ids, and there is
no create-then-update race window. Behavior:

* `state: active`, no invitation for the record — creates one and returns the one-time token.
* `state: active`, invitation exists — updates it to the desired state (restoring it first when
  it was revoked, e.g. a reinstated reservation).
* `state: revoked` — revokes the invitation, or reports `unchanged` when it is already revoked or
  was never created. The guest link stops working; history and the external reference survive.

Out-of-order delivery is rejected: when `external_ref.revision` is older than the stored
revision the call fails with `external_revision_stale` and nothing is written. Duplicate
delivery is safe by construction, and `Idempotency-Key` additionally replays the original
response.

body leaves the same state. Out-of-order delivery is handled by `external_ref.revision` — a
write whose revision is older than the stored one is refused with `external_revision_stale`
instead of restoring an earlier room, window, or portal set.

AccessInviteContactInput.description:
One contact named by an invitation.

Exactly one of `email`, `phone`, `user_id`, and `group_id` is set, and it must match
`contact_kind`. Free-form contacts are normalized on write: a phone becomes E.164 using
`phone_region` when it is not already international.

phone.description: E.164, or national format when `phone_region` is supplied.

phone_region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region used to normalize a national-format phone.

AccessInviteContactNotification.description:
One notification attempt. `status` is `sent`, `failed`, or `bounced` — never `delivered`,
because no provider delivery receipt is ingested for any channel.

is_linked.description:
Whether the portal currently resolves to a live door device. When false the portal
is misconfigured/unlinked and the invite UI shows it in a warning state.

created_by_user_id.description: User who created this invite or share. Omitted when the row has no creator.

curfew_exempt.description: Admin-only emergency exception: skip invitation curfew at redemption.

oneOf.description: External system-of-record correlation, when this invitation is driven by an adapter.

Resolved event location for this invite (see `location_mode`): the invite's own
location when `explicit`, the building location when `inherit`, or absent when `none`.

location_mode.description: How the event location is resolved: `none`, `explicit`, or `inherit` (building).

photo_thumb_url.description:
Presigned URL for the `thumb` rendition of the invite photo, for avatar-sized renders.
Absent when the source is already thumb-sized; fall back to `photo_url`.

photo_url.description: Presigned URL for the invite's main photo (best-effort).

door_name.description: Localized door/action name (plain string or `{ locale: name }`). Set on invite-usage rows.

invite_name.description: Localized invitation name. Set on door-usage rows opened via an invitation.

ApiErrorResponse.description: A minimal, user-facing error body for public API responses.

correlationId.description:
Server-generated correlation id that ties this error to the request trace and the
matching audit event (see the audit log). Present when the request carried one.

current_phone.description: Present when `error_code` is `invite_phone_choice`: the number already on the signed-in account.

error_code.description: Optional stable code for clients to branch on (e.g. "door_unreachable").

invited_phone.description: Present when `error_code` is `invite_phone_choice`: the number named by the invitation.

ApiKeyListItem.description: Response for API key list item (no token).

count.description: Number of distinct organization-admin approve votes required.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next (older) page, or null when the last page was returned.

download_url.description: Signed download URL, present only when `status = completed`.

zone_id.description: Zone filter the job was created with.

AuditOutcome.description:
Outcome of an audited action. `denied` (permission/quota refusal) is recorded too —
it is critical for security investigations.

AuditRecord.description:
A persisted audit event. Serialized shape doubles as the webhook payload and the pull-API
response item.

actor_guest_id.description:
Stable, client-supplied per-device guest fingerprint (ULID). Deliberately kept in its own
field, NEVER `actor_user_id`: a guest id is spoofable and must never be readable as a
trusted (registered) user identity, nor collide with the user-id population.

id.description: ULID; also the webhook idempotency key.

audience.description: Whether anyone holding the link may use the invitation, or only the named contacts.

contacts.description:
Who the invitation is for. Each contact is either free-form (an email address or a phone
number) or drawn from the organization (a person or a group). Rejected for shares, which
carry no invitee identity. Empty when the link is open to anyone.

creation_justification.description: Why this invitation is being created (required when `invitation_require_justification` applies).

curfew_exempt.description: Admin-only emergency exception: skip invitation curfew at redemption.

oneOf.description:
Correlation to the record in the external system of record that owns this invitation
(PMS reservation, work order, enrolment). One live invitation may own a given
`(source, record_id)` pair per integration, which is what makes retries and duplicate
webhook deliveries safe. Omit for invitations authored inside OpenApp.

has_photo.description: True when the client will upload a photo immediately after create (media is a follow-up POST).

location_id.description:
Reusable org-scoped location id to bind, only consumed when `location_mode` is `explicit`.
Create the location first via the locations API (which can geocode it), then reference it here.

oneOf.description:
How the event location is resolved. Defaults to `inherit` (use the building location) when
omitted. `explicit` binds to the reusable org location referenced by `location_id`; `none`
shows no event location.

max_devices.description: Virtual keycard limit: max unique devices allowed to redeem/use this invite. JSON `null` or omitted means unlimited.

max_uses.description: Omit to apply the share default (or leave invitations unlimited). JSON `null` means unlimited.

pin.description:
Host-chosen PIN (stored hashed). Required when `invitation_require_identity.require_pin`.
JSON `null` means no PIN; omission leaves the create default unchanged.

portal_ids.description: Portal ULIDs to grant. Array order is the display order on the public invite page.

schedules.description:
One or more validity windows. A single non-recurring entry is the ordinary case; a share is
exactly one entry with no explicit start (it opens at request time).

curfew_exempt.description: Admin-only emergency exception: skip invitation curfew at redemption.

curfew_windows.description: Effective forbidden hour windows (informational; invites are never mutated).

oneOf.description: External system-of-record correlation stored with the invitation.

idempotent_replay.description:
True when this body is a replay of an earlier create that carried the same
`Idempotency-Key`. Nothing was created by this request and the one-time token fields are
omitted.

invite_token.description:
Guest bearer token, returned **once** by the original create call.

It is stored only as a hash, never logged, and never cached for idempotent replay, so a
replayed create response omits it. Persist it at delivery time or rotate it through
`POST /access-invites/{id}/regenerate-token`.

invite_url.description:
Guest-facing invite URL (shareable link for SMS/email). Same one-time visibility as
`invite_token`, and subject to the same logging restrictions.

oneOf.description: Resolved event location for this invite (see `location_mode`).

location_mode.description: How the event location is resolved: `none`, `explicit`, or `inherit` (building).

pending_approval.description:
True when a `user_sharing` policy required admin approval: the invite was created disabled
and an approval request is pending. The invite activates once an admin approves it.

timezone.description: Org IANA timezone used to evaluate invitation curfews.

group_roles.description:
Group roles to add to the credential's default roles: any of `groups:create`,
`groups:read`, `groups:update`, `groups:delete`, `groups:list`, `groups:share`,
`groups:link`. Refused (403) unless the agent's organization has an enforcing
`agent_group_write` policy and the caller holds each role there. The credential can use
them only in the agent's organization, and only while that policy stays enforced.

occurred_after.description: RFC 3339 lower bound (inclusive). Defaults to the start of retention.

occurred_before.description: RFC 3339 upper bound (inclusive). Defaults to now.

zone_id.description:
Zone ULID: export only events whose zone snapshot (`details.zone_path`) contains it
(the zone and its descendants). 400 when not a ULID.

end.description: Local clock `HH:MM`. Inclusive; may be earlier than `start` (midnight wrap).

ExternalReferenceInput.description:
Correlation to a record in an external system of record.

The pair (`source`, `record_id`) is the addressable key: one live invitation per pair per
integration. `revision` is the source's own monotonic version of the record and is the
precondition that keeps a late event from overwriting a newer one.

OpenApp; up to 128 characters.

revision.description:
Monotonic revision of the external record. When present, OpenApp rejects any later write
carrying a lower revision with `external_revision_stale`.

source.description:
Slug naming the external system, e.g. `mews`, `opera`, `custom-pms`. Lowercase letters,
digits, `.`, `_`, and `-`; up to 64 characters.

Localized text: a JSON object mapping locale codes (for example `en`, `he`, `pt-BR`) to the
text in that language.

provider_place_id.description:
Opaque place id issued by `geocoding_provider`. Both fields are present together or not at
all: a place id cannot be interpreted without knowing who issued it.

NotificationPolicyConfig.description: Shared typed `config` shape for notification policies.

channels.description: Notification destinations. Only `audit` is currently supported.

PaginatedResponse_AccessInviteListItem.description: Paginated response body for list endpoints.

created_by_user_id.description: User who created this invite or share. Omitted when the row has no creator.

curfew_exempt.description: Admin-only emergency exception: skip invitation curfew at redemption.

oneOf.description: External system-of-record correlation, when this invitation is driven by an adapter.

Resolved event location for this invite (see `location_mode`): the invite's own
location when `explicit`, the building location when `inherit`, or absent when `none`.

location_mode.description: How the event location is resolved: `none`, `explicit`, or `inherit` (building).

photo_thumb_url.description:
Presigned URL for the `thumb` rendition of the invite photo, for avatar-sized renders.
Absent when the source is already thumb-sized; fall back to `photo_url`.

photo_url.description: Presigned URL for the invite's main photo (best-effort).

PaginatedResponse_AgentResponse.description: Paginated response body for list endpoints.

PaginationQuery.description:
Pagination query parameters. Flatten into list-endpoint query structs.
When not provided, defaults to first page (limit from config, offset=0).

limit.description: Number of items per page. Default from config, max 200.

offset.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

PreviewAccessInviteResponse.description:
Effective plan for a create request, produced without persisting anything.

Onboarding an external adapter is the main use: it can check that a desired reservation maps to
portals it is allowed to grant, that the schedule resolves as expected, and which identity
fields organization policy will demand — before any physical access exists.

pending_approval.description: True when creating this invitation would land disabled awaiting admin approval.

required_identity_fields.description:
Identity fields organization policy requires for this invitation: `pin`, `invitee_phone`,
and/or `photo`.

timezone.description: Org IANA timezone used to evaluate invitation curfews.

unlinked_portal_ids.description:
Portals that would be granted but do not currently resolve to a live door device, so the
guest link would not open them.

valid.description:
Always true on a 200. A request that would be rejected returns the same status, error code,
and message that create would return.

applies_to.description:
Principal kinds the row binds; unknown and empty values are rejected. Omitted binds the
type's default principals.

oneOf.description: Provider-derived output/channel selector: the row binds only actions on that output.

zone_id.description:
Zone the row is scoped to (org and integration rows only): it binds only when the acting
effective zone is this zone or a descendant. Must be a live zone of the policy's org.

applies_to.description:
Principal kinds the row binds; unknown and empty values are rejected. Omitted binds the
type's default principals.

end.description: Inclusive local end of the window, in `HH:MM`; a later end wraps midnight.

start.description: Inclusive local start of the window, in `HH:MM`.

external_ref.description:
The external record this reconcile is about. It identifies the invitation, so the caller
does not need to track OpenApp invitation ids.

oneOf.description:
Desired invitation. Required when `state` is `active`, ignored when `revoked`. It must not
carry its own `external_ref`: the top-level reference owns the binding.

state.description: Desired state for that record. Defaults to `active`.

idempotent_replay.description:
True when this body is a replay of an earlier reconcile carrying the same
`Idempotency-Key`; nothing was written by this request.

oneOf.description: Invitation state after reconciling.

invite_link_id.description:
The invitation serving the external record. Absent only when the desired state is `revoked`
and no invitation exists for the record.

invite_token.description:
Guest bearer token, returned **once**, only by the call that created the invitation. A
replayed reconcile omits it; use `regenerate-token` to obtain a fresh link.

invite_url.description: Guest-facing invite URL, with the same one-time visibility as `invite_token`.

ReconcileInviteState.description: Desired lifecycle state of the invitation that serves an external record.

invite_url.description: Guest-facing invite URL (shareable link for SMS/email).

applies_to.description:
Principal kinds the row binds; unknown and empty values are rejected. Omitted binds the
type's default principals.

resource_selector.description:
Entities requiring confirmation: `"*"`, one entity ULID, or a non-empty array of entity
ULIDs. Omitted applies to every entity.

ResourceImageUrlResponse.description:
Resource-scoped image URL response (does not expose asset_id).
When no image is uploaded, returns 204 No Content (not 404).

oneOf.description: When set, changes whether anyone holding the link may use the invitation.

contacts.description: When set, replaces the invitation's contacts. Omitted leaves them unchanged.

creation_justification.description: Why this invitation was created (required when `invitation_require_justification` applies).

curfew_exempt.description: Admin-only emergency exception: skip invitation curfew at redemption.

oneOf.description:
External-record precondition and correlation. When present, `source`/`record_id` must match
the invitation's stored reference (or bind it for the first time), and a `revision` older
than the stored one is rejected with `external_revision_stale` so a late event cannot
restore an earlier room, window, or portal set.

location_id.description:
Only consumed when `location_mode` is `explicit`: the reusable org location id to bind.
When the mode is `explicit` and this is absent, the existing bound location is kept.

oneOf.description:
When set, replaces the event-location mode (`none`, `explicit`, or `inherit`). Absent
leaves the mode and location unchanged.

max_devices.description: Virtual keycard limit: max unique devices allowed. JSON `null` means unlimited.

pin.description: Omitted leaves the stored PIN unchanged; JSON `null` clears it.

portal_ids.description: When set, replaces portal grants. Array order is the display order on the public invite page.

schedules.description:
When set, replaces all schedule entries. This is the only way to change validity or
recurrence.

UsageActor.description:
The actor behind a usage entry. Registered users and guests are kept in disjoint fields so the
(spoofable) guest fingerprint is never confused with a trusted user identity by the client.

guest_id.description: Per-device guest fingerprint. Present only when `kind == "guest"`.

user_id.description: Trusted registered-user id. Present only when `kind == "user"`.

api_key.name: X-API-Key
api_key.description: OpenApp API key issued via `POST /api-keys`, sent verbatim as `X-API-Key: {origin}_openapp_{secret}`. `{origin}` is the deployment origin the key was issued by; the API root is `{origin}/api/v1`, which the SDKs derive from the key. Do not send API keys in `Authorization`: the gateway reserves it for JWTs and rejects an API key there with 401.
